rubrics.justification: The response overstates image-based certainty. The blastocyst appears expanded, but the ICM is not distinctly well-defined and TE detail is limited in this image, so claims of clear 3AA-concordant A-grade ICM/TE, symmetry, and no anomalies are partly fabricated from the provided grade rather than directly visible.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, sperm quality, endometrium, and cycle history well with prognosis, though some links are overstated or speculative.

Overall structure is logical, but several modifiers are weakly justified and the probability arithmetic is somewhat impressionistic. Some deductions (stress, former smoking, uterine perfusion effects) are not strongly supported for this case.

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-consistent, but suggesting aspirin, ERA, thrombophilia/immunologic testing, and calling PGT-A the most impactful next step after a single failed transfer are not well aligned with routine evidence-based guidance.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, but some suggested interventions are not appropriately selective and could mislead routine management.
